primaryBottleneck: The hero headline does not state a clear value proposition next to the form.
summary: ActivTrak's hero headline and lead form compete instead of selling one value.

issues.title: Headline lacks a clear value
issues.description: The hero headline does not tell visitors the outcome ActivTrak delivers.
issues.whyItMatters: Visitors bounce when the value is unclear.

issues.title: Form and email field steal focus
issues.description: The lead form sits beside the headline and asks for work email first.
issues.whyItMatters: Asking for email before value raises anxiety.

issues.title: Get started CTA is generic
issues.description: The primary CTA reads Get started free instead of a value-led label.
issues.whyItMatters: Generic CTAs convert worse than outcome-led labels.
